title: Show food and water reserve outlook in the colony HUD
outcome: Players can see whether recent farm deliveries and pump output can sustain the colony before deciding where to expand.
scope: Dedicated Food and Water HUD hover details in WH30K_VS01 using the shared colony UI
Observe one full simulated month of farm food actually delivered to the colony and pump water retained by the colony
Compare observed monthly supply with current population demand and estimate time to empty during a deficit
Keep the existing headline stock-only coverage distinct and restart observation after loading or replacing a colony
acceptance: Hovering either reserve metric exposes the current stock, stock-only coverage, observed supply, current demand and net change as applicable
Deficit, surplus, zero demand, empty stock and incomplete observation show the appropriate state
Simulation pause freezes observation and orbital resupply and in-transit farm food are excluded
Save and load preserve reserve balances and other existing contracts while restarting the observation
Focused simulation and Unity checks exercise the calculation and playable UI, with applicable rendered layout evidence recorded
nonGoals: Change consumption, production, cargo, staffing, power or storage rules
Add save fields, change stable building IDs or scene metadata, or change the pinned Unity Editor and rendering pipeline
Introduce alerts, automated construction or changes to the colony HUD layout
rollback: Revert the feature pull request. The outlook is derived session state, so rollback requires no save migration.

design.reference: Independent design review in the 2026-11-09 Codex chat. Issue #43 records the agreed scope within the existing survival and persistence rules.
